fingerprint: Taiwan +886 phone is truncated, a disabled 7-11 result is selected, or eMap remains on Id/Default.aspx after a store result is chosen
root_cause: The worker capped raw phone digits before converting Taiwan country code; store onclick matching was not exact; nearby recommendations require the official ShowDisableMsg session state; and Playwright coordinate clicks on the result li did not trigger its onclick in this page
mitigation: Normalize +886 to local 09 format in a tested utility; parse and compare exact GoMap or ShowDisableMsg store IDs; fail closed on disabled stores; keep any nearby-store alias local and revalidate it against the official eMap; load recommendations through ShowDisableMsg; and invoke GoMap only after an exact selectable official result is present

evidence.safe_checkout_diagnostic: five recipient/store fields present at /cart/detail before submit

fingerprint: npm.ps1 cannot be loaded because running scripts is disabled
root_cause: Windows PowerShell execution policy may block npm.ps1
mitigation: Use npm.cmd in every formal setup, run, and verification entrypoint

fingerprint: MyShip or Facebook login is missing after moving to another computer
root_cause: Browser login state is machine-specific and must not be copied
mitigation: Create a target-machine-only profile or approved CDP browser and let the user complete official login or MFA

fingerprint: A MyShip run closes or disrupts a shared CDP Chrome session
root_cause: Persistent-context cleanup was used for both owned and shared browser sessions
mitigation: Current server.js and scripts/myship-sync.js distinguish shared CDP from owned profiles, close only the page, and detach the Playwright CDP connection

fingerprint: Render does not automatically create MyShip orders
root_cause: MYSHIP_AUTO_ORDER_ENABLED is intentionally false to avoid cloud-side duplicate or unauthenticated order creation
mitigation: Use the authorized local worker; do not enable Render automation without a separate explicit decision and end-to-end duplicate-safety test

fingerprint: HAXX status reports that the LINE MyShip repository or worker is missing
mitigation: Set LINE_MYSHIP_REPO_ROOT on the target HAXX environment and verify paths before starting the worker

fingerprint: No module named pytest in the HAXX virtual environment
root_cause: The current HAXX runtime does not include pytest, while the scoped tests use the standard unittest framework
mitigation: Run python -m unittest tests.test_line_myship_status_performance tests.test_proxy_performance -v; do not install pytest just for this handoff

fingerprint: Split-Path cannot bind Path because PSScriptRoot is empty during parameter default binding
root_cause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 does not reliably populate PSScriptRoot while default parameter expressions are evaluated
mitigation: Formal scripts accept an empty path default and resolve PSScriptRoot inside the script body; regression-test setup and verify without ProjectRoot

fingerprint: ManagementDateTimeConverter ToDateTime rejects CreationDate during cleanup
root_cause: Get-CimInstance already returned CreationDate as a DateTime, but cleanup treated it as a DMTF string
mitigation: Handle DateTime and DateTimeOffset directly, use DMTF conversion only for string values, and return a nonzero exit code for partial cleanup

fingerprint: Post-install verification reports node_modules or logs as unlisted files
root_cause: Archive immutability checks were applied after legitimate target-machine installation created runtime files
mitigation: Always verify listed file hashes; enforce no-extra-files only in pre-install PackageMode

fingerprint: Compress-Archive cannot access run-history.jsonl because another process is using it immediately after package verification
root_cause: Windows may release the verification child process file handle shortly after the process reports completion
mitigation: Wait briefly, compress to a .partial.zip path with at most three attempts, delete only the owned partial ZIP between attempts, and move to the final immutable ZIP name only after success

root_cause: The login-only action was mapped to the order-processing worker rather than a browser-page-only action
mitigation: Open the official MyShip page in the current browser; the HAXX login-only endpoint returns its URL without starting a worker, reading credentials, or invoking upstream login launchers; include UI and endpoint safety tests in verification and handoff

fingerprint: GM2506169881759 public page 0102M1; original shop and amount product both off shelf
root_cause: Read-only designated-account seller UI confirms both shop and original product selling states are off shelf; who changed them and when are not attributed
mitigation: Keep the original GM URL and amount specification; obtain specific approval before relisting the exact original shop and product, preserve price/stock/shipping, then read back public purchasability independently; do not create a new product, substitute another shop, retry old completed orders, or mistake generic browser login for worker CDP connectivity

resolution: After the user's specific approval, relisted only original shop GM2506169881759 and original product 2506160687864918; independent seller-page readbacks and a fresh public-page inspection confirm normal selling states and no 0102M1; compared 23 shop and 15 product non-selling text-entry/radio controls with pre-write baselines
